content: Chapanga na bhando bhake
Nilonge uchakaka, nombine na Kilichitu, nilonge jhe uwange. Mwojho gwango ujheketelana na Uhuke gwa Chapanga kubhehe ne nilonge jhe uwange.
Nenga nipala kulonge naha, ngwete ungolongonde twe na lipyanda lyangajhomokela kumwojho gwango.
Kwa nhwalo ngahotwi kujhopa mme na likoto na mme kutale na Kilichitu kwa nhwalo jha makalongo bhango Akayahude, bhando bha likabila lyango.

Bheniya ndi bhando bha Ichilahele, Chapanga abhahagwile bhabhe bhake, jwabhalangii ung'alicho gwake, ajhakuhenga malaghano nabho, na kwapekeya lilaghalikilo lyakwe. Ndela jha kunnyinamila jwenie na lilaghano lyakwe.
Ndi ichokolo ya akahokolo bha Akaebulaniya, na Kilichitu akabhelwike kiyegha kuhumii mu likabila lyabhe. Chapanga ndi jwalongocha mambu ghoha, na alombwe machiko ghoha ghangapeta! Amina.
Nilonge jhe kubhehe lilaghano lya Chapanga lilepalile, nhwalo chi bhando bhoha bhu ku Ichilahele ndi bhahaghulilwe na Chapanga.
Na chi ichokolo yoha ya Ulahimo ndi yana ya Chapanga. Nambo Chapanga akanaghile Ulahimo, “Kupete kwa Isaka ndi nampata kibheluko chininnaghile.”
Nhwalo bhala bhubhabhelwike kiyegha, yenio yana ya Chapanga jhe bhala bhubhabhelwike kwa lilaghano lya Chapanga bheniya ndi bhibhalangilwa yana ya Ulahimo.
Chapanga akabhekite lilaghano lyake naha, “Kipinde ngita chenje nahika kabhele na Sala napapa mwana munalome.”
Gheniya tuu jhe, hele Lebeka akibha na mabhela ghinalome jwabhapapite kwa tate jhumo, jwenio ndi hoko gwito Isaka.
Nhwalo yana yenio ya mabhela nakubhelukwa jhe hilu bhanatumbuu jhe kuhenga lyolyoha lyambone amu lyanganandela, chapala Chapanga kibhehe nganganga,
Chapanga akannongolile Rebeka, “Mwana nkolongwa natumikila unung'una mundo.”
Majhandiko gha Chapanga ghilonge, “Nikampahii Yakobu nambo nikachimwite Echau.”
Bho, ngohe tulonge nike? Bho, Chapanga ilolokeya kumiho? Nahi jhe.
Nhwalo Chapanga akanobholile Mucha, “Nanintangatila mundo jhojhoha jhunipala kuntangatila, naninkolela kiya mundo jhojhoha jhunipala kumone kiya.”
Gheniya ghoha ghihobholela kiya jha Chapanga, na chi chapala mundo amu chahenga mundo.

Kwa nhwalo Majhandiko gha Chapanga ghilonge naha kwa Falao munahota jwa ku Michile, “Nikantei mme manahota makolongwa, uhotolo gwa kulangii makakala ghango ghamanyikane kupete mwenga na liina lyango limanyikane nnema ghoha.”
Ndi kulonge Chapanga unkolela kiya mundo jhola jwapala kumone kiya, na apahii kuntenda mundo abhehe na lighoho, utenda abhehe na lighoho.
Lilaka na kiya jha Chapanga
Pange jhumo pakate jhino nangonya, “Anda mambu ghabhii naha, nhwalo gwa nike Chapanga atuhadabula? Bho, ghane nahotola kughahibhilikiya ghala ghapala Chapanga?”
Ngohe mwe ma mundo ghane jhumunyanguu Chapanga naha? Kihulo kihoto jhe kunkonya jwabhomba, “Nhwalo gwa nike umombite naha?”
Jwabhomba ihoto kubhombela ihulo ibhele kwa undope ghumo ngita chapala, chimo kwa lihengo lya maha na chenge kwa lihengo lya kila lichiko.
Naha ndi chi kwa Chapanga. Apata kulangii lilaka lyake na makakala ghake. Nambo akabhahimbilile hake bhando bhala bhubhapata bhahadabulwe na lilaka lyake, bheniya ndi bhibhatopila kukomelekelwa.
Helahela apata kulangii ung'alicho gwake twe gwatujhitii twenga bhitupala kupoke kiya jhake, twenga akatulenganikiye kuhumii makacho tupoke ung'alicho gwake.
Nhwalo twenga ndi bhitukemitwe, chi kuhumii pakate jha Akayahude tu, helahela kuhumii kwa bhando bha ilambo henge.
Ngita chalonge Bhambo mukitabo cha Hocheya jwakibha nnondole jwa Chapanga,

content.text: Na jwenio, nanangiya upalo gwango mu ilambo hela yangambala.”
Na pala pabhalobholila, mangota bhando bhango jhe. Peniya nabhakemwa,

content: Na Isaya jwakibha nnondole jwa Chapanga anonoha lilobhe kulonge, “Pamonga na ibheluko ya Akaichilahele kubhehe twe ngita ncheke gwa kumbwane, bhando bhandina tu ndi bhibhapala kughombolelwa,
nhwalo, Bhambo natenda kajhombe kwahadabuu bhando bhoha pannema.”

Ngita Isaya nnondole jwa Chapanga palongolila kulonge, “Bhambo jwabhii na makakala, nakutuleke jhe kibheluko cha Ichilahele, bhoha ngatukomelekiye ngita bhando bhu ku Sodoma, na kwito ngakulandina ngita ku Gomola.”
Pauli abhajhope bhando bhu ku Ichilahele
Ngohe bho, tulonge nike? Bhando bha ilambo henge bhakatehi jhe kilebhe kubhalangilwa bhaumbone palonge jha Chapanga, bhabhalangilwe bhaumbone palonge jhake kwa ndela jha kihobholelo,
nambo bhando bhu ku Ichilahele bheniya bhakapalii lilaghalikilo lya kutendwa bhabhonekane bhaumbone palonge jha Chapanga nambo bhakabhonikine jhe bhaumbone palonge jha Chapanga.
Nhwalo gwa nike bhakabhonikii jhe bhaumbone palonge jha Chapanga? Nhwalo bhakahobholii itendwa yabhe, bhakauhobhole jhe kihobholelo. Yene, “Bhajhakukochokana mu lighanga lya kukobhondokela.”
Ngita chighalonge Majhandiko gha Chapanga,

content.text: na lyenio ndi nalyantenda bhando bhakobhondoke.
Mekite lighanga lilipala kwatenda bhando bhagweghe.
Nambo mundo jhojhoha jwapala kunhobholela nakola ng'o hone.”
